title: The Infinite Library
prompt: Cinematic photoreal grand library reading room at dawn, one worn blank library card beside an open book in the warm foreground, endless branching shelves and stairways receding through many architectural wings, practical lamps, blue daylight through high windows, deep three-plane composition, no people, no readable text.
negative_prompt: people, faces, hands, readable text, letters, words, logo, watermark, cartoon, illustration, collage, split-screen, malformed architecture, floating books
usage: Primary hero and thumbnail base. Title overlay: THE INFINITE / LIBRARY. Runtime hero scenes use the committed image prompts in script.json.
